title: vercel-labs/skills
title_zh: 开放智能体技能工具 - npx skillsskills

paragraphs.en: The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: 开放智能体技能生态系统的命令行工具。

paragraphs.en: Agent skills are reusable instructions that teach coding agents how to perform tasks, from reviewing code to working with a library. Discover skills at skills.sh .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能是可复用的指令，用于教会智能体如何执行任务，从代码审查到使用某个库。 可在 skills.sh 上发现技能。

sents.en: Agent skills are reusable instructions that teach coding agents how to perform tasks, from reviewing code to working with a library.
sents.zh: 智能体技能是可复用的指令，用于教会智能体如何执行任务，从代码审查到使用某个库。
可在 skills.sh 上发现技能。

paragraphs.en: Supports OpenCode , Claude Code , Codex , Cursor , and 75 more .
paragraphs.zh: 支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 以及另外 75 个。

paragraphs.en: Requires Node.js 22.20 or later. Run this from your project:
paragraphs.zh: 需要 Node.js 22.20 或更高版本。 在你的项目中运行以下命令：

sents.zh: 需要 Node.js 22.20 或更高版本。
在你的项目中运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills Choose the skills and coding agents to install to. Skills are installed to the current project by default; add -g to make them available across projects.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills 选择要安装到的技能与编码智能体。 技能默认安装到当前项目；添加 -g 可使其在多个项目中可用。

sents.en: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills Choose the skills and coding agents to install to.
sents.zh: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills 选择要安装到的技能与编码智能体。

sents.en: Skills are installed to the current project by default; add -g to make them available across projects.
sents.zh: 技能默认安装到当前项目；添加 -g 可使其在多个项目中可用。

paragraphs.en: # Choose one skill and agent npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code # Browse available skills npx skills find See the installation reference for source formats, private repositories, and all options.
paragraphs.zh:
# 选择一个技能和智能体
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code

# 浏览可用技能
npx skills find

安装参考文档包含源格式、私有仓库及所有选项的说明。

paragraphs.en: Read the CLI reference or run npx skills --help for examples and options.
paragraphs.zh: 请阅读 CLI 参考文档或运行 npx skills --help 查看示例与选项。

paragraphs.en: Generate a prompt for a skill, or launch a supported coding agent with it:
paragraphs.zh: 为某个技能生成提示词，或用它启动一个受支持的编码智能体：

paragraphs.en: npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines --agent claude-code Omit --agent to print the prompt instead. See skills use .
paragraphs.zh: npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines --agent claude-code 省略 --agent 则改为输出提示词。参见 skills use。

paragraphs.en: Some npm packages bundle instructions for your agent alongside their code:
paragraphs.zh: 一些 npm 软件包会将其代码与针对你的智能体的指令捆绑在一起：

paragraphs.en: npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y Sync links packaged skills into your project so they update with the dependency. It also supports skill packs declared in package.json . This feature is experimental; its options and behavior may change as we iterate. See npm skills and automatic setup .
paragraphs.zh: npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y 同步操作会将打包的技能链接到你的项目中，使其随依赖一起更新。 它还支持在 package.json 中声明的技能包。 该功能为实验性功能；随着我们的持续迭代，其选项和行为可能会发生变化。 参见 npm skills 与自动设置 。

sents.en: npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y Sync links packaged skills into your project so they update with the dependency.
sents.zh: npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y 同步操作会将打包的技能链接到你的项目中，使其随依赖一起更新。

sents.en: It also supports skill packs declared in package.json .
sents.zh: 它还支持在 package.json 中声明的技能包。

sents.en: This feature is experimental; its options and behavior may change as we iterate.
sents.zh: 该功能为实验性功能；随着我们的持续迭代，其选项和行为可能会发生变化。

sents.en: See npm skills and automatic setup .
sents.zh: 参见 npm skills 与自动设置 。

paragraphs.en: The CLI detects installed agents and lets you choose where skills are installed. See all supported agents, installation paths, and compatibility .
paragraphs.zh: 该命令行界面（CLI）会检测已安装的智能体，并允许你选择技能的安装位置。 查看所有受支持的智能体、安装路径和兼容性。

sents.en: The CLI detects installed agents and lets you choose where skills are installed.
sents.zh: 该命令行界面（CLI）会检测已安装的智能体，并允许你选择技能的安装位置。

sents.en: See all supported agents, installation paths, and compatibility .
sents.zh: 查看所有受支持的智能体、安装路径和兼容性。

paragraphs.en: npx skills init my-skill Edit the generated SKILL.md with instructions for your agent. See creating and sharing skills for the format and discovery rules.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills init my-skill 编辑生成的 SKILL.md，写入供你的智能体使用的指令。 有关格式和发现规则，请参阅创建与共享技能。

sents.zh: npx skills init my-skill 编辑生成的 SKILL.md，写入供你的智能体使用的指令。

sents.en: See creating and sharing skills for the format and discovery rules.
sents.zh: 有关格式和发现规则，请参阅创建与共享技能。

paragraphs.en: The CLI collects anonymous usage data. Set DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 to disable telemetry and security-audit requests. See what is collected .
paragraphs.zh: 该 CLI 会收集匿名使用数据。 设置 DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 或 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 即可禁用遥测和安全审计请求。查看收集的内容。
